yosemite-after-dark-2026.summary: An interactive naturalist walk after dark. Bring a flashlight; suggested for ages 11 and over.

valley-floor-tour-2026.cost: Adults 13 and over $41.25; children 2 to 12 $28.25; age one and under free on an adult's lap. Confirm the final charge.

glacier-point-tour-2026.summary: A four-hour bus tour to Glacier Point; one-way hiker tickets are drop-off only. NPS's conditions page updated October 10, 2026 (reviewed October 12) listed Glacier Point Road open, which does not by itself mean the tour is running; confirm road access and departures with the operator. Overnight parking along the road and in its lots is banned from October 15.
glacier-point-tour-2026.schedule: Daily departures at 8:30 am and 1:30 pm; the operator gives October 12 as the last day while the Guide says October 11. NPS's October 10 update listed the road open. Confirm road access and tour operation, and watch for firefighters along the road.
glacier-point-tour-2026.location: The Yosemite Valley Lodge lobby entrance, shuttle stop 7.
glacier-point-tour-2026.cost: Round trip: adults 13 and over $72.50, children 2 to 12 $50.50. One way: $28.50 and $18.25; age one and under free. Confirm the final charge.
glacier-point-tour-2026.registration: Book online or on 888-413-8869, collect tickets at the Lodge front desk and be ready to board at least 15 minutes early. Ask for ADA accommodations before arrival. Confirm operation and charges; the tour is separate from park entry.

grand-tour-2026.registration: Book online or on 888-413-8869, collect tickets at the Lodge front desk and be ready to board at least 15 minutes early. Ask for ADA accommodations before arrival. Confirm operation and charges; the tour is separate from park entry.

mariposa-nature-walk-2026.summary: A ranger walk among the giant sequoias. NPS extends the season through November 30 only while the Grove shuttle runs, and both can end early with road conditions. Allow time to park and ride the shuttle before the start.
mariposa-nature-walk-2026.schedule: Daily 9:30 to 11 am through November 30 while the Grove shuttle operates. NPS explicitly supersedes the Guide's October 17 end date; confirm the shuttle and the program before travelling.
mariposa-nature-walk-2026.registration: Drop in, no reservation. Park at the Mariposa Grove Welcome Plaza near the South Entrance and ride the free shuttle two miles to the Arrival Area; only vehicles with a disability placard may drive up. No pets on the shuttle or in the grove. Confirm the shuttle and program with NPS.
